name: Nharuk

social.notes: Territórios individuais, encontros reprodutivos; fêmea cuida de 1–3 filhotes. Ecótipos tropical e temperado/planície pertencem à mesma espécie, cruzamento possível em zonas de contato.

ecologicalRelationships.notes: Predation probability must consider hunger, target vulnerability, cover, terrain, fatigue, prey alarm, and counterattack. No guaranteed kills, instant detection or endless pursuit.

vision.notes: Upper reference for temperate/plains; tropical 30 m moving/12 m still. Only with line of sight; blocked by trees and terrain.

hearing.notes: Tropical 35 m; attenuation by wind, rain, vegetation and distance.

smell.notes: Tropical 38 m; direction-dependent odor trails fade with weather/time.

locomotion.notes: Temperate/plains reference. Tropical 1.1 m/s walk, 11.5 m/s sprint for ~6s. Terrain/obstacles and stamina matter; prototype tuning only.

threatResponse.notes: Threat display and low growl; prioritizes retreat from adult Torvalho and dangerous groups. No supernatural sense or aggression without need.

artDirection: Original Auralis quadruped predator inspired by the jaguar's ecological role, not a jaguar reproduction. Elongated body, wedge-like head, angular brow, small keratin cheek plates, short bristled nape/shoulder crest, four padded clawed paws, powerful forequarters, long tail with flattened tuft. Fur pattern consists of discontinuous angular stripes, never jaguar rosettes. Tropical compact olive/rust/charcoal; temperate and plains larger ochre/copper/earth, stronger shoulders. Real 3D mid-poly mesh, credible skeletal rig, distinct proportions and physically readable animation.
notes: Creature 005 design draft. Both ecotypes are one species. Art, rig, GLBs, animations, AI, and integration are NOT yet made; when created GLBs must be pushed and verified on GitHub per AGENTS.md.
